relationships.subject: Gallic Acid
relationships.evidence_quote: alleviates IVDD by targeting HIF-1α to inhibit oxidative stress-induced pyroptosis in NPCs

relationships.subject: TBHP
relationships.evidence_quote: tert-butyl hydroperoxide (TBHP)-induced NPCs degeneration (swelling, apoptosis, ROS accumulation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and pyroptosis-related protein upregulation)

key_findings: Gallic acid from Duhuo Jisheng decoction alleviates TBHP-induced NPC degeneration and IVDD in rats by targeting HIF-1α.
HIF-1α overexpression abrogated gallic acid's anti-pyroptotic effects.
